title: Highly efficient removal of o-nitrophenol by a green Ag@ZnFe2O4/BC catalyst via Fenton-like oxidation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,33549-33560
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05235A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abdelazeem S. Eltaweil, Kristina Samir, Eman M. Abd El-Monaem, Gehan M. El-Subruiti
A sustainable Fenton-like catalyst (Ag@ZnFe2O4/BC) was fabricated from lime juice and waste lime peels. The catalyst demonstrated efficient o-nitrophenol degradation via synergistic adsorption–oxidation pathways.
